gloss: somewhat late; on the late side

definitions.gloss: somewhat late; on the late side; a bit slow
definitions.explanation: Formed from {遅|おそ}い plus the suffix め. Indicates being later or slower than average, but not extremely so — 'a bit late.'

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{遅|おそ}めに{起|お}きた。
examples.english: Today I got up a bit late.

examples.japanese: {夕食|ゆうしょく}は{遅|おそ}めの{時間|じかん}に{食|た}べる。
examples.english: We eat dinner at a somewhat late hour.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}が{混|こ}むので、{少|すこ}し{遅|おそ}めに{家|いえ}を{出|で}ることにした。
examples.english: Since the trains get crowded, I decided to leave home a little on the late side.

notes:
The suffix め attaches to an adjective stem to mean 'somewhat ~' or 'on the ~ side.' {遅|おそ}い (late) → {遅|おそ}め.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遅|おそ}めに{出|で}る: to leave a bit late
- {遅|おそ}めの{時間|じかん}: a somewhat late hour
- {遅|おそ}めの{昼食|ちゅうしょく}: a late lunch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {早|はや}め: somewhat early — the antonym, formed the same way
- {遅|おそ}い: late; slow — the plain adjective, without the softening め
